rationale: The benchmark candidate routes to structured_delivery because it affects product semantics, runtime, release behavior, and six canonical owners. Compact Delivery prerequisites are not evidenced, and Verified Change is ineligible due to multiple owners, release impact, and non-deterministic propagation.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Product semantics, runtime, and release impacts are explicitly present.
The evidence identifies 6 canonical owners across 8 source paths and 8 derived paths.
Verified Change requires exactly one canonical owner, no release impact, and deterministic propagation when derivedpaths
Compact Delivery requires a completed Brownfield Review selecting stored quick_task context; neither completion nor that
